name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Menus that cover their trigger, with icons, dividers, submenus, checkbox and radio items and a hover mode.
improvements: Radix menu semantics: arrow keys, type-ahead, Home/End, Escape and focus return to the trigger.
Rendered in a portal with flip/shift collision handling, so menus are never clipped by overflow containers or pushed off-screen.
Hover mode stays keyboard and touch accessible.
Adds submenus, checkbox and radio items, labels and shortcuts.
